name: smwgraphics-redrawn-paper-mario-styled-koopas
title: Redrawn Paper Mario Styled Koopas
description:
A simple set of redrawn graphics which give Icegoom's SMW Koopas the appearance of enemy koopas seen Paper Mario and Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door.

Graphics are included for both the normal Blue Shelless Koopa from his graphics hack pack, and for the alternate variation done by me.

Credit's not needed but appreciated regardless.
